customer_reply:
Hi Copperfield Brands team,

Thank you for reporting the issue with bulk‑approving purchase orders. This is a known defect that can cause the Approve button to be disabled when selecting many POs. Our engineering team is investigating and will provide a fix before your quarter‑end deadline. We’ll keep you updated on progress.

Best regards,
Support Team
